GROW & GLOW ✦
Welcome to KEYS Gunjur

A thoughtful beginning makes all the difference.

The early years are full of firsts: the first question, the first friendship, the first “I did it myself!”. At KEYS, we want those moments to feel joyful, meaningful and full of possibility.

Our learning experiences invite children to observe, experiment, communicate and build confidence—without rushing childhood.

Discover our approach
The KEYS Difference

Little experiences.
Lasting foundations.

Discover what makes KEYS Gunjur special: hands-on discovery, Aqua Time, language-rich learning and a safe, nurturing environment.

How learning feels here

Less “sit still”.
More “let’s find out”.

Children make sense of the world by trying things, talking about them and trying again. We aim to make room for that natural process through a balance of guided activities, free exploration and connection.

👀

Notice

Look closely, wonder and ask questions.

👐

Explore

Use materials, movement and imagination.

💬

Express

Share ideas through words, stories and art.

🌱

Grow

Build confidence one small success at a time.

Curiosity is a superpower.We give it room to grow.
A wider view of learning

Small beginnings.
A world of possibilities.

Early learning should build foundations children can carry with them—into school, friendships and the world beyond.

01

Thoughtful by design

Learning experiences shaped with a structured, analytical eye and a deep respect for how young children grow.

02

Part of the local learning journey

Grounded in Gunjur, with an understanding of the wider school community and the next steps families consider across Varthur and Gunjur.

03

Ready for what comes next

Communication, curiosity, independence and social confidence—foundations that matter well beyond the preschool years.
